messages:
olivia: Heads up — deploybot scheduled a runtime pin for tonight's hotpatch window (03:00 UTC) for runtime v3.2.x. Question: does a runtime pin prevent automatic model-variant fallbacks or only block runtime upgrades?

deploybot: automated: scheduling pin runtime=v3.2.* window=2026-04-02T03:00Z reason='hotpatch memory regression' initiated_by=@olivia. Pin will apply to hosted and dedicated pools unless override tag is present.

maya: quick clarifier — we need to know if customer pinned models (sticky model versions) are unaffected, and whether routing will still fallback to older runtime-compatible model variants on capacity failures.

jun: My read from the pin semantics doc: runtime pin blocks runtime version changes; model routing can still fallback to compatible older model variants unless we explicitly add model pin. But double-check with release-cp.

alex: +1 to Jun. Also practical note: we saw a case last month where a runtime pin + implicit model rollback led to a mismatch because the newer model assumed kv-cache layout present in runtime 3.3. So fallback needs a compatibility check.

release-cp: Confirming: deploy routing looks at compatibility labels before attempting fallback. If a fallback model's compatibility label excludes the pinned runtime, deploybot will not route to it.

olivia: Ok, so to be safe for tonight I want to do two things: 1) pin runtime v3.2.* (as scheduled) and 2) add a short-lived model-pin-exemption list for a couple of models we know are safe for older runtimes (llmx-hotpatch-v1, llama-q-lite). That will allow fallbacks to those variants only.

maya: Sounds good. Can we add the exemption list via deploybot tag? Example: `deploybot tag pin:exempt=llmx-hotpatch-v1,llama-q-lite`

deploybot: automated: accepted tag syntax. To apply run: 
```
/deploybot pin runtime=3.2.* --exempt-models=llmx-hotpatch-v1,llama-q-lite --expires=2026-04-02T05:00Z
```

tim: Two more asks: update the release notes (short blurb) + set canary to EU-west first, latency SLO watch on warmup. If anything odd, abort and rollback pin.

jun: Rollback runbook note: if we see >0.5% 5xxs or token-latency p95 increase >150ms sustained for 5m on canary, we remove the pin and trigger runtime hotpatch rollback to previous pinned runtime 3.1.x and route models back. Decision owner: @olivia (oncall).

olivia: I'll take decision ownership and monitor. Maya, can you add the release note snippet and update the incident channel invitation?

maya: On it. Release note: "Runtime pin v3.2.* for hotpatch window to mitigate recent memory regression. Temporary model-exemptions applied for llmx-hotpatch-v1 and llama-q-lite. Canary in eu-west; rollback criteria defined in channel."

release-cp: Also pushing a small compatibility telemetry check before applying pin: quick job will validate annotations for the top-10 fallback models against runtime v3.2.* (takes ~3min). I'll kick it off at T-20.

olivia: Perfect. If deploybot reports green on the check, proceed with the pin and exemptions. If not green, abort and we escalate to runtime-team for a hotfix.

deploybot: automated: preflight compatibility job queued by release-cp. JobID=cb-20260402-77. Will post results here when complete.

alex: logging note for postmortem if needed: include pin manifest, exempt-list, routing logs, and the compatibility-job output hash.

maya: tagging docs owners @eng-docs to update pin semantics page with a short example for exempt-list usage (we keep seeing confusion).

olivia: Thanks everyone — syncing again at T-10.
